name: Kisaragi Sora
source:
Occupation: Virtual Idol 
Activities: Going Home Club
Favorite things: Sleeping in, small animals
Hobbies: MMORPG
Special skills: Good with computers, commenting on videos
Problem areas: Getting up early 
Sora is the voice provider for the popular virtual idol, AIR. She enrolled at Gingira Academy in order to see AIR gain international fame. 
However, Sora is rather lazy when it comes to schoolwork, and she tends to attend class acting as AIR, rather than being herself. 
But when it comes down to it, Sora takes her career seriously, and has made great achievements all on her own.
Her measurements grow up to 92(G)-53-87
